positions.name: CalibrationAssertionAndVerification
positions.frame: How does the lead astronomer assert and verify instrument calibration as a settled state?
positions.why: Both expressions are Quill Ashgrove's expert assertions: src-1 declares the calibration complete at a precise frequency, src-2 reports verification against named reference plates and claims validity across the full band. They share a calm-positive affect, technical register, expert power stance, and claim-level conviction — one directional read of calibration as an asserted-and-verified state performed by the lead astronomer.
